title: The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
title_zh: 答案知道往哪里看：在视觉词元预算下让多模态大语言模型在回答前进行缩放

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible. Zooming in recovers the evidence, but the region must be chosen before the model answers. We find that MLLMs know where the evidence is, but not in a form that can be read before they answer: the answer tokens localize it from the middle layers on, whereas the attention available before answering does so only in the top layers, at a depth that varies across models, and diffusely. Supervising the pre-answer attention to point degrades reading, and the benefit of zooming is governed by each image’s information gap. Building on these findings, we introduce LookZoom, which lets an MLLM look where its answer would. A dedicated look token, processed in a single prefill and kept out of the answering pass, learns in hindsight to attend as the model’s own correct answers do, extracting this knowledge into a concentrated pointer before any answer exists. Its hidden state then selects how to look, from no zoom to crops, square windows, windows that adapt to the pointer and foveated warps, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view. LookZoom needs no box annotations, per-model layer search, external localizers or generation before the answer. On Qwen3-VL at three scales and five text-rich benchmarks, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 4.8 4.8 – 9.1 9.1 points at 98 visual tokens per view and attention-guided zooming by 11.1 11.1 – 17.0 17.0 points, while running faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过视觉标记读取图像，在高效部署所要求的每张图像小预算下，文档、图表和信息图中的精细文字变得无法辨认。 放大可以恢复证据，但必须在模型回答之前选定区域。 我们发现，MLLM 知道证据在哪里，但并不是一种能在回答之前被读取的形式：回答标记从中层开始就能定位证据，而回答之前可用的注意力只在顶层做到这一点，且所在深度因模型而异，并且是弥散的。 用监督方式让回答前的注意力指向目标会降低阅读能力，而放大的收益由每张图像的信息差距决定。 基于这些发现，我们提出 LookZoom，它让 MLLM 看向其回答将会看向的地方。 一个专用的 look 标记在一次预填充中处理并保持在回答过程之外，通过事后学习像模型自己的正确回答那样进行注意，从而在任何回答存在之前将这一知识提取为一个集中的指针。 其隐藏状态随后决定如何看待，从无缩放到裁剪、方形窗口、适应指针的窗口以及中央凹式变形，并由每个视角的反事实结果进行监督。 LookZoom 不需要框标注、逐模型的层搜索、外部定位器或在回答之前生成内容。 在三个规模的 Qwen3-VL 和五个文本丰富基准上，它在每个视角 98 个视觉标记下超过最强基线 4.8 4.8 – 9.1 9.1 分，超过注意力引导放大 11.1 11.1 – 17.0 17.0 分，同时运行速度快于注意力引导和基于定位的放大。

paragraphs.en: Reading a receipt, a chart or an infographic requires seeing small text. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) see an image through visual tokens whose number grows with its resolution [ 2 , 1 , 11 ] , and long documents, multi-image prompts, video and on-device inference all cap the number of tokens each image may use. Under such a budget the image is downsampled, and the text that answers the question often becomes illegible. With 98 visual tokens per image, Qwen3-VL-8B averages 48.2 48.2 on five text-rich benchmarks, against 82.2 82.2 with 392 tokens (Tab. 1 ).

paragraphs.en: A natural remedy is to look again : re-encode the relevant region at a higher effective resolution, again within the per-view budget. The region has to be chosen before the answer exists. Training-free methods choose it from the model’s own attention, since MLLMs know where to look [ 33 ] ; the challenge is to read this knowledge at the moment the region must be chosen. ViCrop [ 33 ] crops around the attention of the answer-start position, whereas AttWarp [ 5 ] first generates an answer and then warps the image along the attention of the generated tokens. These two choices expose a dilemma. The attention available before answering is cheap but, as we show, localizes the evidence only in the top layers, at a depth that differs across models, and diffusely, while the attention of the answer tokens localizes it from the middle layers on but exists only after an answer has been generated. Other methods prompt or train the model to name the region with box coordinates [ 20 , 38 , 36 , 10 ] , which again requires decoding before the answer, and naming a region is hard when its text cannot be read.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的补救办法是再看一眼：在每视图预算内，以更高的有效分辨率对相关区域重新编码。 该区域必须在答案存在之前选定。 免训练方法从模型自身的注意力中选择该区域，因为多模态大语言模型知道该看哪里 [ 33 ] ；难点在于必须在必须选定区域的时刻读取这一知识。 ViCrop [ 33 ] 围绕答案起始位置的注意力进行裁剪，而 AttWarp [ 5 ] 则先生成一个答案，然后沿着生成 token 的注意力对图像进行变形。 这两种选择暴露出一个两难困境。 回答之前可获得的注意力虽然开销小，但正如我们所展示的，它只在顶层（不同模型所处的深度各异）以弥散的方式定位证据；而答案 token 的注意力虽然能从中层开始定位证据，却只有在答案生成之后才存在。 其他方法通过提示或训练让模型用框坐标说出该区域 [ 20 , 38 , 36 , 10 ] ，这同样需要在答案之前进行解码，而当区域内的文字无法读取时，说出该区域是很困难的。

paragraphs.en: We study how an MLLM should look again under a budget and find three regularities (Sec. 3 ). First, the model knows where the evidence is, but before answering this knowledge is hard to read: in the middle layers the answer tokens place 1.5 1.5 – 1.8 × 1.8{\times} more attention on the evidence than the answer-start position (Fig. 1 ), whose attention catches up only late and diffusely. Second, pointing and reading compete for the same attention: supervising the pre-answer attention to point sharpens it but costs reading accuracy. Third, the value of looking again is governed by each image’s information gap, the ratio between its native and budgeted resolution, and so is the choice of the best view.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究在预算约束下 MLLM 应如何再看一眼，并发现了三条规律（第 3 节）。 首先，模型知道证据在哪里，但在回答之前这一知识难以读取：在中间层，答案词元对证据的注意力比答案起始位置高 1.5 – 1.8 倍（图 1），而答案起始位置的注意力只有到后期才以分散的方式追上来。 其次，指向与读取争夺同一份注意力：监督回答前的注意力去指向会使其更敏锐，但代价是读取准确率下降。 第三，再看一眼的价值由每张图像的信息差距（即其原生分辨率与预算分辨率之比）决定，最佳视图的选择也是如此。

paragraphs.en: We therefore let the model look where its answer would . LookZoom appends a dedicated <look> token to the prompt. The token has its own position-specific parameters and is removed from the answering pass, so learning to point does not interfere with reading. Trained to attend as the model’s own correct answers do, it extracts their localization into a single prefill by hindsight distillation , read from a fixed band of middle layers, without box annotations, layer search or external networks. Its hidden state drives an action head that chooses, per sample, whether and how to look (no zoom, a crop, a square window, a window adapted to the spread of the pointer or a foveated warp), supervised by the counterfactual outcomes of every view. The model then answers from the low-resolution view and the selected view, or from the selected view alone in a replace variant.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们让模型看向它的答案将会指向的地方。 LookZoom 在提示词后追加一个专用的 <look> 标记。 该标记拥有自己与位置相关的参数，并在回答阶段被移除，因此学习指认不会干扰阅读。 它被训练为以模型自身正确答案的方式注意，通过后见之明蒸馏将其定位信息提取为一次前填充，从一个固定的中间层区间读取，无需边界框标注、层搜索或外部网络。 其隐藏状态驱动一个动作头，为每个样本选择是否看以及如何看（不缩放、裁剪、方形窗口、适应指针分布的窗口或注视式变形），并以每个视图的反事实结果作为监督。 随后，模型从低分辨率视图与所选视图进行回答，或在替换变体中仅从所选视图回答。

paragraphs.en: Looking again. Guided visual search [ 28 ] and chain-of-thought with evidence boxes [ 20 ] showed that re-encoding a relevant region helps MLLMs perceive small details. Many methods name the region in text: Zoom-Refine [ 32 ] predicts a box with a preliminary answer, ZoomEye [ 22 ] runs a training-free tree search over sub-patches, and RL-trained agents emit box coordinates during multi-turn reasoning [ 38 , 34 , 36 ] , where LFPC [ 36 ] builds training images with an information gap; all of them decode text before the zoomed view is read. Training-free methods derive the region from attention: ViCrop [ 33 ] crops around the relative attention of the answer-start position, HiDe [ 12 ] decouples the attention of individual question tokens, LookWise [ 23 ] zooms only when the model is unsure, and AttWarp [ 5 ] warps the image along the attention of a generated answer, with a distilled single-pass predictor and a classifier that decides whether to warp. GapSight [ 40 ] learns whether and where to crop from the loss gaps of candidate crops.
paragraphs.zh: 再看一次。 引导式视觉搜索[ 28 ]和带证据框的思维链[ 20 ]表明，对相关区域重新编码有助于多模态大语言模型感知微小细节。 许多方法在文本中命名该区域：Zoom-Refine[ 32 ]基于初步答案预测一个框，ZoomEye[ 22 ]在子图像块上运行免训练的树搜索，经强化学习训练的智能体在多轮推理中输出框坐标[ 38 , 34 , 36 ]，其中LFPC[ 36 ]构建了带有信息差的训练图像；它们都在读取放大视图之前先解码文本。 免训练方法从注意力中推导该区域：ViCrop[ 33 ]围绕答案起始位置的相对注意力进行裁剪，HiDe[ 12 ]解耦各个问题词元的注意力，LookWise[ 23 ]仅在模型不确定时才放大，AttWarp[ 5 ]沿生成答案的注意力对图像进行变形，并配有蒸馏得到的单次前向预测器以及决定是否变形的分类器。 GapSight[ 40 ]从候选裁剪的损失差距中学习是否裁剪以及在哪里裁剪。

paragraphs.en: Attention as a pointer. Attention maps of MLLMs localize visual evidence well [ 33 , 9 ] . SD-RPN [ 24 ] distills the attention of the model’s own responses into an added region-proposal branch, Q-Zoom [ 26 ] adds a gate that skips high-resolution processing when it is not needed, and region-level policy optimization [ 25 ] refines such a predictor with RL. Other work shapes attention during training against annotated boxes [ 6 , 17 , 8 , 18 , 39 ] or a generated focus cue with a box-trained detector [ 29 ] . Self-Saliency [ 3 ] rewards two heads for attending to the regions that an external grounding model finds for the objects named in the model’s own reasoning; we do not steer the shared attention. Our analysis locates this signal before and while answering, and shows that supervising the shared attention trades reading for pointing (Sec. 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Positioning. LookZoom differs from these methods in three ways. (i) Its pointer is a dedicated token inside the MLLM, computed in the same prefill as the question without generating an answer or coordinates; its own parameters isolate pointing from reading. (ii) It is distilled in hindsight [ 37 ] from the attention of the model’s own correct answers and read from a fixed band of layers, without box annotations, external grounders or a per-model search for layers. (iii) It chooses among several view types from the same token, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view, instead of making a binary zoom decision [ 5 , 26 , 40 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 定位。 LookZoom 与这些方法的不同之处有三点。 （i）其指针是 MLLM 内部一个专用的 token，与问题在同一轮 prefill 中计算得出，无需生成答案或坐标；其专属参数将指向与阅读隔离开来。 （ii）它从模型自身正确答案的注意力中进行事后蒸馏 [ 37 ] ，并从固定的层带中读取，无需框标注、外部定位器或针对每个模型的层搜索。 （iii）它从同一个 token 中在多种视图类型之间进行选择，并由每种视图的反事实结果进行监督，而不是做出二元的缩放决策 [ 5 , 26 , 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We first examine how an MLLM should look again when its visual tokens are limited, using Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] without any training. To measure where the model looks, we use V-CoT-Doc, a held-out document split of Visual CoT [ 20 ] whose 300 questions come with evidence boxes, and define the evidence mass as the fraction of the attention to the image that falls inside the evidence box. Unless stated otherwise, attention maps are averaged over heads and over the band of middle layers from which LookZoom reads its pointer, and smoothed identically for all variants; a uniform map has an evidence mass of 0.040 0.040 at 196 tokens.

paragraphs.en: Observation 1: The model localizes the evidence, but before answering only late and diffusely. A zooming decision has to be made before the answer exists, e.g . from the attention of the answer-start position [ 33 ] . In the middle layers, this pre-answer attention places only 0.107 0.107 / 0.097 0.097 / 0.095 0.095 of its mass on the evidence (2B / 4B / 8B at 196 tokens, Fig. 2 ), whereas the attention of the answer tokens places 1.5 1.5 – 1.8 × 1.8{\times} more ( 0.167 0.167 / 0.142 0.142 / 0.144 0.144 ); for correctly answered questions it is as accurate as the attention obtained by teacher-forcing the ground-truth answer ( 0.187 0.187 vs . 0.188 0.188 on 2B). The model therefore knows where the evidence is. Before answering, however, this knowledge surfaces only in the top layers, at a depth that differs across scales (layers 17–20 of 28 for 2B, 21–24 and 28–31 of 36 for 4B and 8B; per-layer curves in the supplementary material), and even there most of the attention falls outside the evidence ( 0.174 0.174 / 0.158 0.158 / 0.162 0.162 ). Existing methods either read the pre-answer attention at a fixed relative depth [ 33 ] or generate an answer to read the attention of its tokens [ 5 ] . We instead extract the localization of the answer tokens into a token that is read from a fixed band of middle layers before any answer is generated (Sec. 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Observation 2: Pointing and reading compete for the same attention. The direct remedy is to supervise the pre-answer attention with the answer-time attention while fine-tuning the model with RL. This sharpens pointing, raising the evidence mass of the 2B model to 0.217 0.217 / 0.247 0.247 at 196 / 392 tokens, but it costs reading: compared with the same RL fine-tuning without this loss, single-view accuracy drops in 8 of 11 benchmark–budget settings, by up to 2.7 2.7 points (protocol in the supplementary material). paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare with the strongest training-free methods that point with the model’s own attention, ViCrop [ 33 ] and AttWarp [ 5 ] , re-implemented from the official code with the official default settings on the same base model and budget (layer indices rescaled to model depth). In the setting reported by AttWarp, our re-implementations of both methods reproduce the reported gains on DocVQA and also improve TextVQA, by smaller margins (supplementary material). Ground-then-crop prompts the model for the bounding box of the evidence in Qwen3-VL’s native grounding format, enlarges the box by its own size on each side, and answers from the low-resolution view and the crop, in the spirit of Visual CoT [ 20 ] and Zoom-Refine [ 32 ] . We re-implement GapSight [ 40 ] , which learns from the loss gaps of candidate crops whether and where to crop, and train its router on the same images as our action head (no code is public; supplementary material). We also report the single low-resolution view. The supplementary material also evaluates DeepEyes [ 38 ] , an RL-trained zooming agent built on a different base model, under the same budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们与最强的免训练方法进行比较，这些方法利用模型自身的注意力进行指向，包括 ViCrop [33] 和 AttWarp [5]，二者均基于官方代码以官方默认设置重新实现，并使用相同的基础模型和预算（层索引按模型深度重新缩放）。 在 AttWarp 报告的设置下，我们对这两种方法的重新实现在 DocVQA 上复现了所报告的增益，并在 TextVQA 上也取得了提升，但幅度较小（见补充材料）。 先定位后裁剪以 Qwen3-VL 的原生定位格式提示模型给出证据的边界框，将该框在每侧按其自身尺寸扩大，然后基于低分辨率视图和裁剪图进行作答，其思路与 Visual CoT [20] 和 Zoom-Refine [32] 一致。 我们重新实现了 GapSight [40]，该方法通过候选裁剪图的损失差距来学习是否裁剪以及在哪里裁剪，并在与我们动作头相同的图像上训练其路由器（其代码未公开；见补充材料）。 我们还报告了单一低分辨率视图的结果。 补充材料还在相同预算下评估了 DeepEyes [38]，这是一个基于不同基础模型构建、通过强化学习训练的缩放智能体。

paragraphs.en: LookZoom achieves the best average accuracy at 98 and 196 tokens at every model scale (Tab. 1 ; examples in Fig. 5 ), and in every column of Tab. 1 the best result comes from one of its two variants. At 98 tokens per view, it surpasses the strongest baseline, Ground-then-crop or GapSight, by + 9.1 +9.1 / + 5.3 +5.3 / + 4.8 +4.8 points (2B / 4B / 8B) and ViCrop and AttWarp by + 17.0 +17.0 / + 11.1 +11.1 / + 13.4 +13.4 points; at 196 tokens it leads by + 5.5 +5.5 / + 4.0 +4.0 / + 4.6 +4.6 points and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline on every benchmark. The gains are largest where the information gap is largest, on the small text of V-CoT-Doc ( + 7.7 +7.7 / + 5.3 +5.3 / + 8.6 +8.6 at 196 tokens); at 392 tokens, where the gap is small, LookZoom remains on par with the strongest baseline ( − 0.2 -0.2 to + 2.7 +2.7 ). With a single view in the answering pass, the replace variant beats AttWarp by 5.1 5.1 – 7.3 7.3 points at 196 tokens and matches or exceeds the two-view Ground-then-crop and GapSight. DeepEyes-7B [ 38 ] trails its base model, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, by 9.8 9.8 – 15.9 15.9 points under the same budgets (supplementary material).
paragraphs.zh: LookZoom 在 98 和 196 token 下于每个模型规模上都取得最佳平均准确率（表1；示例见图5），并且表1的每一列中最佳结果都来自它的两个变体之一。 在每个视图 98 token 时，它超过最强基线 Ground-then-crop 或 GapSight +9.1 / +5.3 / +4.8 点（2B / 4B / 8B），超过 ViCrop 和 AttWarp +17.0 / +11.1 / +13.4 点；在 196 token 时领先 +5.5 / +4.0 / +4.6 点，并在每个基准上匹配或超过最强基线。 增益在信息差距最大处最为显著，即 V-CoT-Doc 的小号文本上（196 token 时为 +7.7 / +5.3 / +8.6）；在 392 token 时，由于差距很小，LookZoom 仍与最强基线持平（-0.2 到 +2.7）。 在回答阶段仅使用单一视图时，replace 变体在 196 token 下超过 AttWarp 5.1–7.3 点，并匹配或超过双视图的 Ground-then-crop 和 GapSight。 在相同预算下，DeepEyes-7B [38] 落后于其基座模型 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 9.8–15.9 点（见补充材料）。

paragraphs.en: Cost. In the accounting of AttWarp [ 5 ] (Tab. 2 ), LookZoom and GapSight need two passes and generate nothing before the final answer, whereas AttWarp and Ground-then-crop first generate an answer or a box and ViCrop needs three passes. LookZoom is therefore faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming ( 0.35 0.35 s per sample vs . 0.38 0.38 – 1.26 1.26 s) and within 0.02 0.02 s of GapSight while 4.2 4.2 points more accurate, and its replace variant, at the token cost of AttWarp, is 1.7 × 1.7{\times} faster than AttWarp.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 在 AttWarp [5] 的统计中（Tab. 2），LookZoom 和 GapSight 需要两次处理且在最终答案之前不生成任何内容，而 AttWarp 和 Ground-then-crop 先生成答案或边界框，ViCrop 则需要三次处理。 因此，LookZoom 比基于注意力的缩放和基于定位的缩放更快（每样本 0.35 秒 vs. 0.38–1.26 秒），与 GapSight 相差仅 0.02 秒的同时准确率高出 4.2 个点，其替换变体在与 AttWarp 相同的 token 成本下比 AttWarp 快 1.7 倍。

paragraphs.en: Where to look. The value of the <look> token grows with how closely the view follows the pointer (Tab. 3 a). Windows of fixed size only need to contain the evidence, and both pointers place them equally well. When the window adapts its size to the spread of the pointer, the <look> token is far better: + 9.9 +9.9 / + 3.2 +3.2 / + 1.5 +1.5 points at 98 / 196 / 392 tokens ( + 10.7 +10.7 / + 9.3 +9.3 at 98 tokens on 2B / 8B) over the pre-answer attention of the same layers, and + 5.7 +5.7 / + 1.6 +1.6 / + 0.3 +0.3 over that of the best top layers, which must be located per model with evidence boxes. A concentrated pointer yields a small, strongly magnified window that still contains the evidence, and the foveated warp gains likewise ( + 5.3 +5.3 / + 3.1 +3.1 / + 0.9 +0.9 ). Pointing matters for every view: at 98 tokens a randomly placed window gains only + 3.5 +3.5 points over the single view, against + 16.8 +16.8 / + 17.3 +17.3 when placed by the pre-answer attention / <look> token.
paragraphs.zh: 往哪里看。 <look> 词元的价值随视图跟随指针的紧密程度而增长（表 3 a）。 固定大小的窗口只需包含证据，两种指针都能同样好地放置它们。 当窗口根据指针的扩散范围调整其大小时，<look> 词元明显更优：相比同层的回答前注意力，在 98 / 196 / 392 词元下分别提升 + 9.9 +9.9 / + 3.2 +3.2 / + 1.5 +1.5 分（在 98 词元下 2B / 8B 模型上分别提升 + 10.7 +10.7 / + 9.3 +9.3），相比最佳顶层（需按模型利用证据框定位）的回答前注意力，分别提升 + 5.7 +5.7 / + 1.6 +1.6 / + 0.3 +0.3。 集中的指针产生一个仍包含证据的小而强烈放大的窗口，中央凹式变形同样获得增益（+ 5.3 +5.3 / + 3.1 +3.1 / + 0.9 +0.9）。 指向对每种视图都很重要：在 98 词元下，随机放置的窗口相比单一视图仅提升 + 3.5 +3.5 分，而由回答前注意力 / <look> 词元放置的窗口则提升 + 16.8 +16.8 / + 17.3 +17.3 分。

paragraphs.en: Training the pointer. In Tab. 4 , sharpening the target is essential: without it the evidence mass drops from 0.229 0.229 to 0.152 0.152 and the adaptive window loses 3.8 3.8 points on average. Restricting the targets to correct answers matters little, since the answer-time attention is on average as accurate as that of the ground truth (Observation 1). Training the shared attention instead of a dedicated token reaches a similar evidence mass but lowers single-view reading and every zoomed view, by up to 2.0 2.0 points: the dedicated pathway lets pointing be trained without harming reading.
paragraphs.zh: 训练指针。 在表4中，锐化目标是至关重要的：没有它，证据质量从 0.229 降至 0.152，自适应窗口平均损失 3.8 个百分点。 将目标限制为正确答案影响不大，因为答案生成时的注意力平均上与真值注意力一样准确（观察1）。 训练共享注意力而非专用令牌可以达到相近的证据质量，但会降低单视图阅读和所有放大视图的效果，最多降低 2.0 个百分点：专用通路使得在不损害阅读的情况下训练指向成为可能。

paragraphs.en: An MLLM knows where the evidence is, but before it answers this knowledge lies late in the network and is diffuse. LookZoom extracts it into a dedicated look token that points and decides how to look in one prefill without interfering with reading, outperforming attention-guided, grounding-based and learned zooming. Multi-step looking, multi-image inputs and video are natural next steps.

paragraphs.en: GapSight. GapSight [ 40 ] trains a router on the frozen model that reads the hidden states of the low-resolution view and decides whether to add a crop and where, supervised by the loss gap of the answer, the negative log-likelihood given the view alone minus that given the view and a candidate crop. No code is public, so we re-implement it from the paper and keep everything else as in our setting. The router of each model is trained on the same 6,000 images as our action head, at 98, 196 and 392 tokens. For each image and budget we score 24 candidate crops, 12 compact windows covering 2 2 – 15 % 15\% of the image with aspect ratios between 1 / 3 1/3 and 3 3 , each also enlarged 1.8 × 1.8\times ; the 40.4 % 40.4\% of the samples with the largest gap are labeled review and the 23.5 % 23.5\% with the smallest keep , the proportions reported by GapSight, and the rest are left out of the gate loss. The router reads the hidden state of the last prompt position at layer ℓ max + 1 \ell_{\max}{+}1 and at the last layer, together with the visual-token states of layer ℓ max + 1 \ell_{\max}{+}1 pooled in 39 prior boxes, and predicts the gate, the utility, the prior box and a bounded residual, trained with the five losses of GapSight. paragraphs.en: The <look> token is thus trained to output, from the prompt alone, where the model’s correct answers attend on average after sharpening. It extracts this localization without sampling or decoding an answer at test time, and it averages out the variation between individual answers.

paragraphs.en: The <look> token is trained for each model, whereas a training-free pointer can be read from the raw attention once its layers are calibrated for that model; the token replaces this calibration by training on the model’s own answers, without box annotations. Its gains concentrate where the information gap is large: at 392 tokens it is on par with the strongest baseline, and at 784 tokens all methods are close. We study text-rich images, where tight budgets make the evidence illegible; zooming into several regions at once and extending the token to video frames are left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: <look> 标记需要为每个模型进行训练，而免训练的指针只需为该模型校准其各层之后即可从原始注意力中读取；该标记通过在模型自身的回答上进行训练来取代这种校准，且无需边界框标注。 其增益集中在信息差距较大的场景：在 392 个标记时它与最强基线相当，而在 784 个标记时所有方法的表现都很接近。 我们研究的是文本丰富的图像，在紧凑预算下证据难以辨认；同时缩放多个区域以及将该标记扩展到视频帧的工作留待未来研究。
